cards.title: Basic Play
cards.description: Draw 1, Play 1

cards.title: Merger Consolidation
cards.description: Two players may combine their Keepers to meet one Goal together. Both players win.

cards.title: Rich Bonus
cards.description: If you have the most Keepers on the table, draw an extra card. In the case of a tie, all tied players get the bonus.

cards.title: Poor Bonus
cards.description: If you have the fewest Keepers on the table, draw an extra card. In the case of a tie, both players get the bonus.

cards.title: Restoring a quorum
cards.description: Draw 2, Play 2.

cards.title: Government requires encrypted back doors
cards.description: Draw 1, Discard 4.

cards.title: Power outage
cards.description: All technology keepers cannot be used.

cards.title: Technical solution to a social problem
cards.description: Only technology keepers can be used.

cards.title: Recent terrorist attack
cards.description: Goals of Privacy, Legislative victory, Policy change cannot be met while this rule is in play.

cards.title: Thwart the Surveillance Agencies
cards.description: While Full Disk Encryption is in play (controlled by any player), every player may treat it as satisfying that requirement for their own Goal.

cards.title: Data Protection Regulation goes into effect
cards.description: The Privacy goal can be met with just 1 keeper.

cards.title: Continuing Resolution
cards.description: Draw 2.

cards.title: Rider Amendment
cards.description: Play 2.

cards.title: Gag Order
cards.description: Hand Limit 1.

cards.title: Antitrust Breakup
cards.description: Keeper Limit 3.

cards.title: Traffic Shaping Policy
cards.description: Choose a player. Their Draw is reduced by 1 (minimum 1) until this Rule leaves play.

cards.title: Bipartisan Agenda
cards.description: 2 Goal cards are in play. Either one can be used to win.

cards.title: Anonymous
cards.description: Once per turn, a player may play one card face-down instead of face-up. It has no effect until any player reveals it on a later turn.

cards.title: Standards Process
cards.description: Hand Limit 2.

cards.title: United Nations Resolution
cards.description: 2 Goal cards are in play. Both must be met together to win.

cards.title: Special Session
cards.description: Draw 3.

cards.title: Divestiture
cards.description: Keeper Limit 2.

cards.title: Grassroots Momentum
cards.description: If you have no cards in your hand at the start of your turn, draw 3 extra cards.

cards.title: Landslide Vote
cards.description: Play All But 1.

cards.title: E-Waste Recycling
cards.description: When the Draw pile is empty, shuffle the discard pile to form a new Draw pile.

cards.title: Sneakernet
cards.description: Everyone chooses one card to pass to the left.  If your hand is empty, you just receive a card (don’t have to draw or pass.

cards.title: Editorial Review
cards.description: Discard half of any individual player's hand. You pick who is under editorial review.

cards.title: Zero Day
cards.description: Take 1 card from up to half the players.

cards.title: Data breach
cards.description: One player has to show their hand.

cards.title: Ransomware
cards.description: Take all but 1 of one player's cards. You pick which player.

cards.title: Mandatory Internet ID (Anonymous posting is banned)
cards.description: All players show keepers in their hands.

cards.title: Tech Hype!
cards.description: Everyone gets to draw a card.

cards.title: Zero Rating
cards.description: Choose a type of card, and then play as many of those cards as you want on your turn.

cards.title: Classified information leaked
cards.description: Every player holding a surveillance agency has to play their keeper. Keeper limits are not enforced.

cards.title: Build an Alliance
cards.description: Count the number of players in the game (including yourself). Draw enough cards to give 1 card to each player, and then distribute them evenly amongst all the players. You decide who gets what.

cards.title: Share the Wealth
cards.description: Gather up all the keepers on the table. Shuffle them together, then deal them out,giving the first card to yourself. Everyone will probably end up with a different number of Keepers in play than they started with.

cards.title: Flash Sale
cards.description: Draw 3 cards. Play up to 2 of them; discard the rest. (Playing these does not count against this turn's normal Play.)

cards.title: Legislature changes hands
cards.description: Reset to Basic Rules. Discard all new rule cards, and leave only the basic rules in play. Do not discard the current Goal.

cards.title: Remote Exploit
cards.description: Take any Keeper from another player's tableau and add it to yours.

cards.title: Feature Deprecation
cards.description: Discard one Keeper from the table, your choice.

cards.title: Tech Company Acquisition
cards.description: Trade one of your Keepers for any Keeper on the table.

cards.title: Botnet
cards.description: Play a Keeper you don't control as if it were your own, for the purpose of meeting a Goal this turn.

cards.title: Special Election
cards.description: Take another turn immediately after this one.

cards.title: Discovery
cards.description: Draw one card from every other player's hand.

cards.title: Disinformation
cards.description: Choose a player. They must discard 1 card, then draw 1 card unseen.

cards.title: Wiretap
cards.description: Look at one player's hand.

cards.title: Stingray Surveillance
cards.description: Look at one player's hand and take 1 card from it.

cards.title: File Comments
cards.description: Look at the top 3 cards of the Draw pile; put them back in any order.

cards.title: Communications Regulatory Agency Ruling
cards.description: Force one player to discard a Rule of their choice that is currently in play.

cards.title: Domain Seizure
cards.description: Take one Keeper from another player and put it in the discard pile. No one gets it.

cards.title: Universal Digital Rights
cards.condition: No Surveillance Agency keeper may be on the table
